experiments.scope: The blake3-r2-prefix-v1 target. Each trial executes the search of proof.md 9.1, 9.8 and 9.9 on the priced instance (flags 3, counter t by step CT) for one context: seven outer words and eight members from the seed, the test of W, the 39 context lines; per member its walk of seven full blocks of 2^16 steps (t_hi below 2^19), each of constant X0 >> 16 with the level-16 test of automaton (2); per live block the first eight words of the whole list of its state, with the packed Y9 fill, the exact packed Y9 prefilter of Lemma PF (a word with no lane that can pass test (1) is skipped), the T1 replicas and the word test on kept words; per passing lane the shortcut, the pre-check of 9.7, the preflight, the joint screen of 9.9 and the joint solver of 9.4 with (G7) and (G15), with the root predicate; for a certified root, both last-chunk compressions at counter t and the 256-bit test. In-run checks: those of proof.md 9.2, with every 61st skipped word re-tested with T1 (uncharged; a pass is a mismatch). The returned pair is built by steps CO and CT on the harness instance (counter 0, flags 11, t_hi = 0) for the trial's context and first passing member. No BLAKE3 library.
experiments.hypothesis: For every trial the two complete 2-round digests (counter 0, flags 11) agree on digest words 0, 2, 5 and 7, the 128 masked bits: after the first half of round 2 the two states differ only in Y3 and Y11, and the only differing message word of the diagonal step is w5; none enters diagonals 0 and 2. The 16 observations are the program's own counts, untrusted: blocks, live, ranges, words, e_lanes (kept words' lanes), passes, prechecked (passing lanes whose pre-check keeps an outcome), solver_calls (prechecked lanes with a row that passes the screen), roots, certified, units, solver_units, checks, mismatches, halted, live_steps. Expected per trial (outcome set S of three rows, proof.md 9.10; the walk of seven full blocks per member): 56 blocks, about 3.6 live, 28 words of which about 3 kept (about 20 E lanes), 0.4 passes, 0.1 prechecked and 0.015 solver calls, almost always no root; mismatches and halted 0. The counter instance cannot be digest-checked by the organizer; the run is not evidence of attack cost.
